newsitem.title: USA: Citation gets $300 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Citation gets $300 mln credit facility.

text.p: Citation Corp said Friday that a group of banks led by First National Bank of Chicago has agreed to provide it with a new secured revolving credit facility of up to $300 million.
It said the facility has a three year term, beginning July 24, 1997.

Citation said its previous credit facility, which had a maximum loan commitment of $230 million, also was led by First Chicago. Currently, its long term debt under the agreement is approximately $180 million, it said.

Citation, which makes metal components for the capital and durable goods industries, has 16 manufacturing divisions located in eight states. It employs about 5,600 people and sales for the first nine months of fiscal 1997 were $488.8 million.
